summary: End-to-end testing of Casefile NCLT auth+doc-gen app. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases passed covering login (success/invalid), /auth/me, protected route enforcement, 5-template listing (fields+table_inputs+columns), missing-field 422, document generation, DOCX/PDF export via ?token= query, DOCX token replacement of {cd_name} and table injection for df_creditors. Frontend: verified login-page render, invalid-credential toast, successful login, workspace load with 5 templates, opening notice-first-coc, inline table editor add/remove/edit rows, filling required fields, generate flow reaching export UI, and logout clearing token.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS default fallback of '*' with allow_credentials=True is not spec-compliant (browsers reject). Currently harmless since CORS_ORIGINS is set to '*' and frontend uses same host, but tighten to explicit origins for production.
The ?token= export URL leaks the JWT in server access logs and browser history. Consider a short-lived signed download URL instead of the full session JWT.
add_data_table uses max(len(row) for row in rows) for cols but rows[0] may be shorter — safe here since headers are always full, but a mismatched CSV import could crash. Consider padding rows.

TableEditor initial rows use Array(2).fill(same reference) — the two rows share the same array object, so editing one row mutates the other via updateCell path (mitigated because updateCell rebuilds with spread, but risky if refactored).
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_-prefixed generated documents (constitution-coc, notice-first-coc) via the API and UI for verification. Not cleaned up but tagged with TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth uses JWT with 12h expiry, bcrypt password hashes, 5-attempt lockout for 15min per (ip,email). /api/documents/{id}/export/{fmt}?token= exists as browser-download fallback and shares logic with /download/. Templates DOCX files present in /app/backend/templates/. Startup refreshes admin password if env changed.
